description: Sudan received a small batch of F-5E and F-5F Tiger IIs in 1982 and 1983. Recorded as preserved at Wadi Seidna by Wrecks and Relics Online but not tied to a mapped point so the site coordinate is the airfield reference rather than a fix on the airframe. Variant E is inferred from the single-seat F-5 designation in that listing and is not independently confirmed.
